title: LuckRead Publish Preflight Operation
purpose: Run stateless publish-readiness checks before a creator submits content for review.

database.reason: Pure analysis; authoritative content persistence remains in D1-02.

checks: AI creation policy and required substantial creator contribution for articles
people-first/original-value signals aligned to Google Search guidance
QR-code/scan text hints and media-reference heuristics

verdicts.YELLOW: Advisory issues exist; creator may continue, subject to normal moderation.
verdicts.RED: A blocking policy/quality issue exists; creator must fix it before review submission.

nonGoals: Pixel-level image OCR or QR decoding
Replacing content moderation or human review
Adding a new Worker or D1 database
